Yoga’s impact on height is contested across sources. Several high-credibility outlets state that skeletal height is fixed after early adulthood and that yoga’s effects are negligible or illusory, improving posture rather than true growth [d1, d4, d6, d12]. Meanwhile, multiple sources assert that specific yoga asanas can activate growth hormones or stretch the body to add a few centimeters or inches, implying actual height increase [d2, d5, d7, d8, d9, d11]. Some sources hedge, noting posture and flexibility benefits without guaranteeing growth [d3, d10].
